    startparms Starting parameters for the optimization. Given a set of ranges of values of environmental variables where the presence of a species occurs,generates a Latin hypercube design for the parameters based on the Sobol' low-discrepancy sequence.

    start_parms.Rd

    startparms Starting parameters for the optimization. Given a set of ranges of values of environmental variables where the presence of a species occurs,generates a Latin hypercube design for the parameters based on the Sobol' low-discrepancy sequence.

    start_parms(env_dat, quant_vec = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9), num_starts = 100)

    Arguments

    env_dat

    The environmental array given the observed occurrences

    quant_vec

    A vector of quantiles. Are the bounds of the range to create the hypercube

    num_starts

    The number of samples of the hypercube

    Value

    A data frame with samples for each parameter to optimize

    Examples

    envdat_ex_occ <- envdat_ex[, , occExample == 1]
start_parms(envdat_ex_occ)
